The Women Empowerment Cell (WEC) of our institution is committed to creating a supportive 
environment that fosters the personal and professional growth of women students and faculty members. 
The Cell organizes various awareness programs, industrial visits, training sessions, and interact ive 
workshops in association with reputed organizations such as CII–IWN (Confederation of Indian 
Industry–Indian Women Network)  to promote leadership, self -confidence, and gender equality. 
Through initiatives like POSH Act Awareness, Self-Protection Workshops, Eco-Friendly Choices for 
Menstrual Hygiene, and visits to centers like the Amara Raja Skill Development Centre, WEC aims 
to educate and empower women to make informed decisions, enhance employability, and contribute 
meaningfully to society. The Cell consistently works towards building a campus culture that upholds 
respect, safety, and opportunities for all women.
